map.Input: 体重 65 kg、人群=健康成人（6 mg/kg）、单杯饮品 95:
Input: weight 65 kg, group = healthy adult (6 mg/kg), single drink 95 mg. 
 Daily safe limit = 65 x 6 = 390 mg; about 390 ÷ 95 ≈ 4.1 Americanos (about 95 mg each). 
 Moderate (3 mg/kg) = 195 mg, high risk (6 mg/kg already included) = 390 mg. 
 Half-life model: after 200 mg, half-life 5 hours → 100 mg left after 5h, 50 mg after 10h. 
 Conclusion: a 65 kg adult's daily limit is about 390 mg (≈4 cups); stop after afternoon to ensure night clearance.

map.孕期咖啡因可透过胎盘且胎儿代谢慢，多国建议 <200 mg/日（约 3 mg/k: During pregnancy caffeine passes the placenta and the fetus metabolizes slowly; many countries suggest <200 mg/day (about 3 mg/kg); teens, with developing nervous systems, are advised ≤2.5-3 mg/kg. map.按半衰期 5 小时，体内残留降至 25 mg 以下约需 4–5 个半衰期（20–: At a 5-hour half-life, residual drops below 25 mg after about 4-5 half-lives (20-25h) to approach clearance, but sleep impact mainly comes from high concentration within 6-8h before bed. Sensitive people are advised to stop intake after noon (14:00).
